messages:
emma: Quick pass — AetherGrid sent the co-branded sales kit comps. Need a legal sign-off on logo lockups + marketing confirmation on CTA sizing. Attaching files in thread.
rahul: Saw the PNGs — quick flag: partner guide says logo only on white or solid dark, no gradients. Can we confirm allowed backgrounds?
liz: Copy from their guide: 'Do not place logo over gradients, photomasks, or patterned backgrounds.' They do allow reversed monochrome on dark.
paul: For the deck we need: hero lockup (600x200 px), compact partner badge (100x100 px) for footer, and alt-text strings. Can design provide examples?
katie-legal: Please don't publish any partner trademarked phrases without LOA. Also confirm any customer quote is cleared by legal — we need partner confirmation for the quote line.
design-anna: Uploaded two variants to the thread: aether-hero-left-redwood-right-v1.png and badge-compact-v2.svg. I'm leaning to the reversed white badge for the dark hero.
emma: Two quick brand rules from our side: 1) partner badge must not be tinted, 2) lockup spacing follows our standard 12px clearspace. Please ensure vector files are provided.
rahul: Partner responded in email: quote is fine but wants wording changed to "up to 3x" instead of absolute. I'll paste their exact suggested copy in a sec.
liz: Suggested neutral phrasing: "AetherGrid and Redwood reduced inference costs by up to 3x in production." Keeps it factual and safe.
katie-legal: That phrasing looks OK provisionally. We still need a signed LOA (logo use + quote approval). I'll send the LOA checklist to RahuL and Emma.
design-anna: Also uploaded templates for marketplace and solution brief: hero-template.psd (16:9), marketplace-tile.ai (1:1). Links: https://files.redwood.ai/aetherkit/v2/hero-template.psd and https://files.redwood.ai/aetherkit/v2/marketplace-tile.ai
paul: Marketing asks: place compact badge bottom-right on marketplace tile, CTA "Get started" button variations x3 for A/B. Need final alt text for accessibility.
emma: Alt text suggestions: "Redwood Inference and AetherGrid co-branded solution logo" and "AetherGrid + Redwood joint solution for high-throughput inference" — feel free to iterate.
asset-bot: Uploaded: hero-lockup-final.png (1.2MB), badge-compact-final.svg (12KB)
rahul: One accessibility note — ensure hero white-on-dark passes WCAG contrast for small text. design-anna can you run a quick check?
design-anna: Checked: current hero color combo passes AA for large text and AA for normal text at 18px, but fails AAA for small captions. We should avoid tiny overlaid copy.
emma: Great catch. Next steps: 1) design to finalize lockups by EOD tomorrow, 2) katie-legal to issue LOA checklist to partner, 3) rahul to confirm final quote phrasing with partner, 4) paul to prepare marketplace/solution-brief templates and CTAs. Ping me with blockers. :thumbsup:
paul: I'll slot marketplace tile into next week's campaign batch.
katie-legal: I'll DM partner legal and start the LOA template. Expect a draft by tomorrow.
rahul: I'll confirm "up to 3x" language with partner and report back here.
emma: Thanks everyone — once LOA + final assets are in, I'll consolidate and send back to partner for final sign-off.
__notes: Per agents.md: single Slack thread represented as continuous string. No title field included.
